modalLead: The Containers view grows up: updates at night with a rollback, a web UI's bookmark and its health, and a notice when a container runs hot.

items.text: Update automatically. Switch it on per container; nextDash updates it at night and rolls it back if it stops, restarts or turns unhealthy.
A web UI's bookmark. A bookmark mark after the link, in the colour of its checks. Click it to open the bookmark.
Notices when a container runs hot on CPU or memory for a while.
Columns, and more ways to sort and group. Hide what you never read; sort by size or restarts; group by network or image.
Network and disk I/O in Resources, now and over the hour.
Disk: remove stopped containers, and measure a bind mount's folder.
The page scrolls again after you close the side panel with the mouse.
